propositions: No purchasable or trial Jira Data Center license and no official OpenAPI spec exist, so a DC adapter cannot be verified against a real oracle.
The story provides a pinned pycontribs/jira-test-image:8.17.1 Docker harness reachable at http://localhost:2990/jira as the DC verification oracle.
Because 8.17.1 is >= 8.14, Personal Access Token bearer auth is exercised for real via Authorization: Bearer.
Teardown verification is index-independent per ADR 0037 §3: it polls each issue's direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint until 404 and never queries search.
All tests carry the existing integration marker so make test excludes them via its -m expression with no Makefile test-target change.
The harness proves REST v2 protocol semantics only, not deployment-specific behavior, with real-instance validation tracked in a separate ticket.
